config._doc: Lane A: official ClickHouse Kafka Connect Sink v1.6.0. https://clickhouse.com/docs/integrations/kafka/clickhouse-kafka-connect-sink
config._doc_exactly_once: at-least-once (default). exactlyOnce=true needs KeeperMap state; not used in this POC.
config._doc_format: schemaless JSON is inserted as JSONEachRow; ISO-8601 'Z' timestamps need best_effort parsing into DateTime64; precise_float_parsing=1 so text->Float64 matches the binary floats lanes B/C send (cross-lane hash). VERIFY: setting names exist in ClickHouse 26.3.
config.errors.deadletterqueue.topic.name: cf.dlq.sink.v1
config._doc_batching: batch size follows the consumer poll (max.poll.records); requires worker connector.client.config.override.policy=All
